title: Markdown Document Outline / TOC & GitHub Slug Extractor
acceptanceCriteria: Matches MarkText getMarkdownHeadingLines: ATX headings (#..######) and setext headings (===/---), ignoring lines inside backtick/tilde fenced code blocks.
Generates Unicode-aware githubSlug matching packages/muya/src/utils/slug.ts (issue #5292) including CJK and accented characters.
Sidebar outline in marktext-gpui renders heading hierarchy and line numbers from marktext-core.
